prompts.name: select_project
prompts.summary: Binds the current repository to one of your SpecFlow projects.

prompts.name: start
prompts.summary: Walks you from a project to a claimed story: areas, stories, preview, claim.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.summary: Lists the SpecFlow projects you are a member of, newest first.

tools.name: list_features
tools.summary: Lists the features in a project's specification graph.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.summary: Lists the tasks of a project's implementation plan; by default the ones ready to start.

tools.name: list_feature_tasks
tools.summary: Lists every plan task that works on one feature, ready or not.

tools.name: get_task_path
tools.summary: Lists the tasks to complete before one plan task, in build order, then the task itself.

tools.name: get_task_brief
tools.summary: Reads what a coding agent needs to build one plan task: done-when, spec sources, prerequisites.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.summary: Lists the work areas of a project's plan with their ready, in-progress, waiting, blocked and done stories.

tools.name: list_stories
tools.summary: Lists the stories of a project's plan in recommended order, or the ones you hold, or the finished ones.

tools.name: preview_story
tools.summary: Shows one story before you take it: state, holder, tasks in build order, what it waits for, findings.

tools.name: claim_story
tools.summary: Takes one story for you and your agent; one claim wins.

tools.name: release_story
tools.summary: Gives a story you hold back, with an optional note.

tools.name: get_story_brief
tools.summary: Reads what an agent needs to start a story: tasks, done-when, spec sources, prerequisites, findings.

tools.name: trace
tools.summary: Traces what a story or spec nodes depend on, or what depends on them, with plan state.

tools.name: get_node
tools.summary: Reads one spec node: edges, plan state, provenance and findings.

tools.name: search_spec
tools.summary: Searches the spec graph by id, text and meaning, optionally near a story or node.

tools.name: similar
tools.summary: Finds spec nodes whose text reads like a story's nodes but that have no edge to them.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.summary: Reads the exact source lines behind one spec node.

tools.name: path
tools.summary: Shows how two spec nodes connect: up to three shortest directed chains.

tools.name: expand_brief
tools.summary: Ranks what to read next beyond a story's brief, within a token budget.

tools.name: add_finding
tools.summary: Records a gap, conflict, question or note about the spec, linked to nodes and code; people answer it.

tools.name: report_task
tools.summary: Reports progress on one task of your claimed story; its status stays until the story completes.

tools.name: complete_story
tools.summary: Closes your claimed story with the merge commit and the pull request.
